UI kit · drawn by Fable

Hand-written SVG from one shared style spec. Hub kit + full UI kit + 230 item icons for v1.0 (M1 + M2). Text-free; the game renders all words.

Hub · rail icons

Painted objects breaking out of a coloured disc. Shown at 72 px (in-game size).

Hub · activities & gauges

Train is a wooden wing-chun dummy (a stone weight read as a padlock).

Hub · banners & frames

Text-free: the game renders words and numbers on top.

Windows, buttons & controls

9-slice pieces keep ornament in the corners so they stretch to any size.

Rarity frames · element badges · stats

Rarity and element read by shape and ornament as well as colour (colour-blind safe).

Status effects · realm seals

Jade rim = buff, vermilion = debuff, black-gold = boss. Seals grow grander up the realm ladder.

Map pieces

Strong outlines and ground shadows so they sit on busy painted maps.

Rewards, quests & badges

Effect sprites

White sprites are tinted per element by the game.

Items · swords (33)

Grip bottom-left, tip top-right. Type reads by silhouette (Jian, Saber, Greatsword, Twin, Flying), tier by material. Frames rotate through rarities for review.

Items · armor (36)

One silhouette per slot; tiers 1–6 escalate in material, never size.

Items · materials (38)

Ores, woods, herbs, fish, pearls, eggs and special materials.

Items · drops (37)

Boss signature drops, pickaxes, axes, furnaces, incubator.

Items · pills (41)

Device = category: jade box gate pill, gold band breakthrough aid, marbling Qi buff, paper twist combat, pair restoration, leaf pet pill, tub bath. Plus fishing rods.

Items · techniques (45)

Methods are bound manuals; combat arts are element-coloured skill tiles; resources; cooked meals and pet food.
